prerequisite: Run compute_quantities on each alignment first so material lists are attached; this node only reads and summarises, it computes nothing
fixture_requirements: >= 2 alignments with material lists (verifies multiple sheets and the summary total)
>= 1 alignment without a material list (verifies skipping and the skipped list)
An alignment whose name contains characters illegal in Excel sheet names (such as [ ] /) (verifies sheet-name sanitising)
assertions: Read-only operation: the drawing is not modified and no save_dwg is needed
sheet1 is 'Summary': No. / alignment name / length (m) / total volume (m3); the last row is the total of the rows above
total volume = the alignment's cumulative cut end value from its material list (matches total_cut_m3 from export_quantities)
summary length = Alignment.Length, matching the drawing
one sheet per alignment with a material list, one row per station (No. / station / cumulative cut / cumulative fill / incremental cut / incremental fill), last row total
sheet order matches the summary row order (dike numbers sort naturally: X-2 before X-10)
sheet name = sanitised alignment name ([]:*?/\ replaced by _, truncated to 31 characters, duplicates get a -2 suffix) so illegal characters do not break Excel
alignments without a material list are skipped and listed in skipped, never dropped silently
when no alignment has a material list, throw and report the skipped count (do not write an empty workbook)
out defaults to outdir\MaterialVolumes.xlsx; when out is given, write there and create the directory if needed
reruns overwrite the same file (the current deliverable is the single source of truth; no copies)
